newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Fujian bank to place 683.7 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Fujian bank to place 683.7 mln shares.

text.p: Fujian Industrial Bank has launched a placement of 683.7 million domestic shares, the Financial News said on Thursday.
The placement, priced at 2.20 yuan per share, would be made mainly with domestic institutions and would raise about 1.5 billion yuan ($181 million). The offer would be completed in March.
It said the shares would be newly issued but it did not give details of the bank's capital structure before or after the offer.
The issue, approved by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, was aimed at enabling the bank based in southeastern China to expand its operations nationwide.
The bank said from its formation in 1988 until the end of last year, its profits had reached a total of 1.28 billion yuan. It gave no breakdown of profits over the years.
The bank had domestic currency deposits of 12.161 billion yuan and outstanding domestic currency loans of 8.6 billion yuan as of the end of last year, the newspaper said.
The bank's foreign exchange savings and loans also surged, it said without giving details. The bank's total assets stood at 22.4 billion yuan at the end of September in 1996, it said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
